meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取基因、序列与蛋白结构等生物数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要快速查询基因、序列和结构等生物数据
copy.tagline_en: Query gene, sequence, and structure data from 20+ bio databases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need quick lookups of gene, sequence, and protein structure data in bio research.

howto.what: Claude 会用 gget 的命令行或 Python 函数去查 20 多个生物信息数据库:基因信息、序列比对、蛋白结构、表达数据等,结果以 JSON、CSV 或 DataFrame 返回。适合单次、交互式的小查询。
howto.when: 当你做单次生物信息查询时触发,例如查基因信息、BLAST/BLAT 比对、AlphaFold 结构等;批量处理或高级 BLAST 它建议改用 biopython。

say.text: 用 gget 查一下人类 ACE2 基因在各组织的表达
say.note: 走 archs4 的 tissue 模式,返回组织表达值。

say.text: 帮我 BLAST 这段蛋白序列,只留前 10 条结果
say.note: 运行 blast 模块,输出命中列表。

say.text: 用 gget search 在人类里找 pax7 相关的基因
say.note: 按基因名搜索,返回 Ensembl ID 等信息。

howto.what_en: Claude uses gget's CLI or Python functions to query 20+ bioinformatics databases: gene info, sequence alignment, protein structures, expression data and more, returning JSON, CSV or DataFrames. Suited to one-off, interactive lookups.
howto.when_en: Triggers on one-off bioinformatics queries, such as gene info, BLAST/BLAT alignment, or AlphaFold structures. For batch work or advanced BLAST it points to biopython.

say_en.text: Use gget to check ACE2 tissue expression in human
say_en.note: Runs archs4 tissue mode; returns tissue expression values.

say_en.text: BLAST this protein sequence and keep the top 10 hits
say_en.note: Runs the blast module; outputs a hit list.

say_en.text: Run gget search for pax7 genes in human
say_en.note: Searches by gene name; returns Ensembl IDs and more.
